text:
liz_support: FYI customer AcmeApp reporting intermittent 5xxs and huge latency — traffic for us-west2 getting routed to eu-west1. Started ~2026-03-15T09:02Z. Ticket #12345 https://redwood.support/t/12345 :warning:

marta_prod: can you drop a sample request id + the exact timestamp they saw the 5xx? region preference configured?

liz_support: req_id=01FZ9XK2, seen at 2026-03-15T09:01:59Z. Customer says they have region=us-west2 pinned. Error in payload: `502 Bad Gateway` from our router after ~1.2s, then routed to eu-west1 next try — back-and-forth.

raj_sre: looked at internal probe logs around that time. Router decided us-west2 heartbeat expired because cached heartbeat timestamp was stale (cache TTL 10s but agent last_seen was much older). Repro snippet from router logs:
```
[2026-03-15T09:01:58Z] probe: region=us-west2 status=healthy last_seen=2026-03-15T08:59:50Z
[2026-03-15T09:01:58Z] router: decision=failover us-west2->eu-west1 reason=heartbeat_expired ttl=10s
```

tim_platform: that looks like timestamp drift between probe-agent and router/cache. Did we roll anything last night?

alice_network: we rolled probe-agent v1.3.4 yesterday — it switched some nodes to use monotonic timestamps for heartbeat writes. A subset of nodes missed the rollout and kept system time writes, so the cache compared them and thought entries were old.

raj_sre: mitigation plan — temporarily increase heartbeat expiry to 45s for affected regions and disable auto-failover for the customer while we patch. Also flush the heartbeat cache for us-west2 so router recalculates.

marta_prod: agree. can we do a soft config flag per-customer? safe_fallback_window = 120s for AcmeApp?

tim_platform: yes — applying now for customer filter. command I ran: `rdwctl config set routing.safe_fallback_window=120s --filter customer=AcmeApp`

raj_sre: repro steps for SRE to verify locally:
1) `curl -H "X-Request-ID: 01FZ9XK2" "https://router.internal/route?region=us-west2" -i`
2) check `X-Last-Heartbeat` header and router logs for `heartbeat_expired` decision
3) inspect cache: `redis-cli -h cache-01 HGET heartbeat us-west2` (should show last_written timestamp)

raj_sre: flushed the cache for us-west2 and bumped TTL on the router: `redis-cli -h cache-01 HDEL heartbeat us-west2` — observed route stabilized.

deploy-bot: deploy: probe-agent v1.3.5 rollout started -> probe-nodes updated 5/20 (rolling).

alice_network: rolling patch will normalize to monotonic timestamps everywhere. Post-patch we'll revert heartbeat expiry to baseline and re-enable auto-failover.

marta_prod: follow-ups: add unit/integration test for monotonic vs system time in probe-agent; add alert if router sees timestamp-drift > 5s across nodes; add a canary for config flag changes.

liz_support: told AcmeApp about mitigation and that we're patching — they report fewer cross-region hits after the cache flush. I'll keep ticket open until probe-agent fully rolled. Thanks team :heart:
